name: date-availability
title: Availability calendar
description: A calendar for booking: which days have free slots and how many, full days off with the reason.

AvailabilityCalendar.description: The Calendar with each day's free slots: a dot, a tooltip and its name. Other props, `ref` included, go to Calendar's root.

props.name: availability
props.description: Free slots per day, keyed by ISO date ("2026-11-26"). 0 is a full day. A day left out has no slots and can't be picked.

props.name: fewSlots
props.description: At or below this many free slots a day reads as nearly full: its dot becomes a ring.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why a day without free slots can't be picked: its tooltip, read after its date. Defaults to "Fully booked" for a day listed with 0.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: More days that can't be picked, whatever their slots.
